site.title: Copilot Analytics Labs — what's new
site.description: Release notes for new Copilot Analytics Labs templates, sample code, research, playbooks, and important fixes.

updates.title: Subscribe to Copilot Analytics Labs updates by RSS
updates.summary: Copilot Analytics Labs now publishes important announcements to an RSS feed. Subscribe from Power Automate, a Teams channel, classic Outlook, or any feed reader to hear about new templates, sample code, research, playbooks, and critical fixes.

updates.title: Cowork Value Estimator methodology published
updates.summary: A new methodology guide explains how the Cowork Value Estimator measures collaboration impact, including the research basis and assumptions behind its business-value calculations.

updates.title: Measure AI business value across the Copilot estate
updates.summary: ValueLens joins the template library with Power BI reporting for hours saved, assisted value, adoption, agent governance, user feedback, ROI, and cost. A sample dataset is included so the report can be explored before connecting a tenant.

updates.title: Copilot credit consumption and cost in one report
updates.summary: Consumption Central joins the template library, bringing Cowork and Work IQ, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Azure AI Foundry consumption and cost into a single Power BI view.

updates.title: Measure team-level Cowork ROI with an anonymized dashboard
updates.summary: Cowork Team Report combines privacy-reviewed member summaries into an anonymized team dashboard covering hours saved, value delivered, work patterns, and outputs. A manager skill can email the dashboard to the team as a scheduled newsletter.

updates.title: Estimate the personal impact of Copilot Cowork
updates.summary: The Cowork Value Estimator adds a personal impact report with research-anchored time saved, professional-services-equivalent value, and work mapped to jobs, business processes, and four value pillars.
